TABLE.NAME: local_coderunner_manager_prototypes
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per CodeRunner question prototype. Holds the prototype's identity and scope; its content lives in the versions table.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The label authors see. Unique among a course's prototypes and all site prototypes taken together, which is enforced in code because the site part cannot be expressed as an index.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the prototype belongs to. SITEID for a site prototype. Scope decides who may edit it and who is offered it, and plays no part in running a question.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: A stable identifier created with the prototype and kept through export, backup and restore, so copies of the same prototype elsewhere can be recognised. Not unique on a site: a restore that cannot use the original creates a copy carrying the same identifier.

FIELD.NAME: builtin
FIELD.COMMENT: True for a prototype shipped with CodeRunner, which each release reinstalls and which authors cannot edit.

FIELD.NAME: issitedefaults
FIELD.COMMENT: True for the single Site defaults prototype that sits at the root of every chain. Unlike a built-in it is created once and never rewritten by an upgrade, because site administrators edit it; and it cannot be deleted.

FIELD.NAME: currentversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The version that questions and child prototypes resolve against. Null only in the moment between inserting a prototype and inserting its first version, inside one transaction.

TABLE.NAME: local_coderunner_manager_versions
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per saved version of a prototype. Each row is complete; differences between versions are computed for display, not stored.

FIELD.NAME: parentid
FIELD.COMMENT: The prototype this version derives from, or null for a root. The parent belongs to the version rather than the prototype, so a prototype whose parent changed still shows its earlier versions correctly.

FIELD.NAME: overrides
FIELD.COMMENT: A JSON document of the field values this prototype sets. A field absent from the document is inherited; a field present with any value, including an empty string, is an override.

FIELD.NAME: summary
FIELD.COMMENT: One sentence, shown in the prototype picker.

FIELD.NAME: documentation
FIELD.COMMENT: Documentation for question authors, shown in the question form once this prototype is chosen. Takes over the role the question text of a prototype question plays in CodeRunner 5.

FIELD.NAME: documentationformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The FORMAT_ constant the documentation is written in, as for any Moodle text field edited through the editor.

FIELD.NAME: commitmessage
FIELD.COMMENT: An optional note from the author describing the change.
